title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Urban Rooftop Gardens
prompt: In many cities, flat rooftops on apartment blocks and office buildings remain unused while public green space is scarce. Some urban planners argue that converting these rooftops into community gardens would improve residents' quality of life, whereas others believe the costs and practical difficulties outweigh the benefits. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on whether cities should require new large buildings to include rooftop gardens. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先花约5分钟审题：圈出题目要求你讨论的两个观点，并明确你需要在结尾给出自己的立场。写作时确保每个主体段只聚焦一个观点，用具体例子（如居民健康、建筑成本、维护责任）支撑论证，并在结论中清楚回应“城市是否应强制新建大型建筑设置屋顶花园”。全文不少于250词，建议用时40分钟，写完后检查是否两个观点都得到讨论且自己的意见明确。
